description_sq:
Jepet per shitje super apartamenti 2+1, kati i 3 banim pallati i ri me ashensor.
Siperfaqa neto 94.5 , bruto 103. Pallati 7 katesh me hyrje nga rruga kryesore. Shkalla e pajisur me ndricim natyral dhe teresisht I veshur me sistem kapot. 
Mundësi ndarje ne 2 AP. Shumë e përshtatshme edhe per aktivitetet biznesi.
 Me pamje jug perëndim. Adresa afer Hotel Mondial. 
Cmimi i shitjes= 258000 euro.
description_en: Super apartment 2+1 for sale, 3rd floor, new residential building with elevator. Net area 94.5, gross 103. 7-storey building with entrance from the main road. The staircase is equipped with natural lighting and is completely covered with a capot system. Possibility of sharing in 2 apartments. Very suitable for business activities. Facing south west. Address near Hotel Mondial. Selling price = 258,000 euros.
